versions.changelog: Fix cart add (PUT→POST) and cart remove (POST→DELETE)

Initial public release: Command-line tool for Austrian online grocery shopping via gurkerl.at.

- Search for products, view details, and add/remove items in your shopping cart.
- Manage shopping lists (create, view, delete, add items).
- View order history.
- Supports login/logout via browser, with session stored in macOS Keychain.
- Designed for scripting/automation with JSON output support.
- Austria only; checkout flow not yet implemented (use website for orders).
